content: Over the years, a handful of QA systems have gained popularity around the world. One of the oldest QA system is BASEBALL (created on 1961) BIBREF4 which answers question related to baseball league in America for a particular season. LUNAR BIBREF5 system answers questions about soil samples taken from Apollo lunar exploration. Some of the most popular QA Systems are IBM Watson, Apple Siri and Wolfram Alpha. Examples of some QA systems based on different languages are: Zhang Yu Chinese question classification BIBREF6 based on Incremental Modified Bayes, Arabic QA system (AQAS) BIBREF7 by F. A. Mohammed, K. Nasser, & H. M. Harb and Syntactic open domain Arabic QA system for factoid questions BIBREF8 by Fareed et al. QA systems have been built on different analysis methods such as morphological analysis BIBREF9, syntactical analysis BIBREF10, semantic analysis BIBREF11 and expected answer Type analysis BIBREF12.
